deadline.value: Fall applications received by February 15, 2027 are considered for all financial awards; the department reviews year-round.
deadline.quote: Applications received for fall semester by February 15 will be considered for all financial awards available

gre_subject.value: The biology page does not mention a GRE.

supervisor.value: Applicants should contact a faculty member first; the student can apply only if that faculty member agrees to work with them.
supervisor.quote: If the faculty member is accepting graduate students and agrees to work with the student, the student can then apply

funding.value: The page lists fellowships and awards but does not say most or all admitted students are funded.

entry_route.value: A bachelor's degree in biology (or an equivalent with prerequisites) is the stated requirement.
entry_route.quote: To be accepted to the program, applicants must have the equivalent of a bachelor’s degree in biology

notes: Degree-finder page for Biology PhD. The $55 fee is reimbursed by the department if the applicant is accepted and enrols. The department page does not state a GRE rule, so the university value applies. Ecology PhD (usu.edu/degrees-majors/ecology_ms_phd) uses the Biology deadline list and a separate environmental track; it is not saved as its own record.
